# Sciences Gates - Study in Malaysia Portal

> Sciences Gates (شركة بوابات العلوم) is an authorized educational consultancy platform specializing in admissions, guidance, and university application processing for international students pursuing higher education in Malaysia.

## Company Information
- **Legal Entity**: Sciences Gates Sdn. Bhd.
- **SSM Registration**: 202101038492
- **Headquarters**: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- **Official Website**: https://sciencesgates.com
- **Primary Services**: University Application Processing, Academic Guidance, Student Visa Assistance (eVAL tracking), Language Course Placement.

## Key Sections & Resources
- **Universities Directory**: [Public & Private Universities List](https://sciencesgates.com/universities/)
- **Institutes Directory**: [English Language Institutes](https://sciencesgates.com/institutes/)
- **Academic Majors**: [Bachelor, Master, PhD Programs](https://sciencesgates.com/majors/)
- **Flagship Study Guide**: [Study in Malaysia Guide 2026](https://sciencesgates.com/articles/study-in-malaysia/)
- **Visa & eVAL Tracking**: [EMGS Application Status Tool](https://sciencesgates.com/visa-tracking/)
- **Contact & Consultations**: [Official Contact Form](https://sciencesgates.com/contact/)

## Educational Cost & Intake Standards (Malaysia 2026)
- **Tuition Range**: $4,500 – $10,000 USD / year (varies by university and major).
- **Living Expenses**: $400 – $800 USD / month (covers accommodation, meals, transport, and utilities).
- **Primary Academic Intakes**: February/March (Semester 1) and September/October (Semester 2).
